how do i put my api key

In `backend/transcriber/.env`, find `GRADIUM_API_KEY` and replace its placeholder with your actual key:

```dotenv
GRADIUM_API_KEY=paste_your_actual_key_here
TRANSCRIPT_BATCH_SECONDS=5
```

Save the file with **⌘S**. Then open [the frontend](http://127.0.0.1:5173), click **Start recording**, and allow microphone access. No backend restart is needed.

Keep your key private—don’t paste it into chat or commit the `.env` file.

## My request:
great here in the transcript it should say name of the speaker instead of room
I’ll use the speaker names already present in the transcript as the labels and update the avatar initials to match.

input.input: text(await tools.exec_command({cmd:"git status --short; cat frontend/src/useTranscription.ts; sed -n '315,328p' frontend/src/App.tsx; entire status","max_output_tokens":4500}));

text(await tools.exec_command({cmd:"python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('frontend/src/useTranscription.ts')
s=p.read_text()
pos=s.index('\nexport function useTranscription')
s=s[:pos]+'''
function transcriptLine(text: string, time: string): TranscriptLine {
  // Existing transcripts may encode the speaker as "Name: words".
  const speaker = text.match(/^([\\p{L}][\\p{L}\\p{M}'’.-]*(?:[ \\t]+[\\p{L}][\\p{L}\\p{M}'’.-]*){0,3}):[ \\t]+(.+)$/u)
  const person = speaker?.[1] || 'Room'
  const initials = speaker
    ? person.split(/\\s+/).map(part => Array.from(part)[0]).slice(0, 2).join('').toUpperCase()
    : 'RM'
  return { person, initials, time, text: speaker?.[2] || text }
}
''' + s[pos:]
s=s.replace("return { person: 'Room', initials: 'RM', time: match?.[1] || '', text: match?.[2] || line }", "return transcriptLine(match?.[2] || line, match?.[1] || '')")
s=s.replace("{ person: 'Room', initials: 'RM', time: message.timestamp, text: message.text }", "transcriptLine(message.text, message.timestamp)")
s=s.replace('`[${line.time}] ${line.text}`', "`[${line.time}] ${line.person === 'Room' ? '' : `${line.person}: `}${line.text}`")
p.write_text(s)
PY
npm run build --prefix frontend; npm run lint --prefix frontend; entire agent-help","max_output_tokens":2500}));

content.text: Named lines now show the speaker’s name and initials, with the repeated name removed from the text. Export still preserves the names. Build and lint pass; audio without a speaker label still shows “Room.”
